description: This file defines exception handling, error translation, and warning handling mechanisms for PyTorch, including custom exceptions, error translation functions, and pybind11 wrappers for error handling functions.

classes.name: python_error
classes.description: Custom exception class for Python errors in C++ with methods to build, persist, and restore Python error states.

classes.name: PyTorchError
classes.description: Abstract base class for exceptions translating to specific Python types.

classes.name: PyWarningHandler
classes.description: Handles Python warnings in C++, buffering and processing them with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: detail::noop_gil_scoped_release
classes.description: A no-operation class for releasing GIL when not needed.

classes.name: detail::conditional_gil_scoped_release
classes.description: Conditional GIL release wrapper based on template parameter.

methods.name: PyErr_SetString
methods.description: Sets a Python error with a message.

methods.name: torch::get_cpp_stacktraces_enabled
methods.description: Checks if C++ stack traces are enabled.

methods.name: torch::translate_exception_to_python
methods.description: Converts C++ exceptions to Python exceptions.
